title: Motion — speed, time and distance
subject: physics
disclaimer: This model assumes uniform speed in a straight line, with no acceleration or stopping; graphic position is scaled.

beats.label: Predict
beats.narration: Predict the distance if speed doubles while time remains constant.

beats.label: Observe
beats.narration: Adjust time and speed; distance equals speed multiplied by time.

beats.label: Reflect
beats.narration: A constant speed gives a linear distance–time relationship.

check.question: A runner moves at 5 m/s for 10 s. What distance?
